notes:
More motion, and achievement pictures that load.

- Achievement pictures on a game page now load. Steam moved the pictures of newer games, so SteamLite now looks in the new place first, keeps a copy, and shows a trophy if a picture really does not exist.
- The tabs on a game page (Overview, Achievements, News and so on) have a highlight that glides from tab to tab, and the page slides in from the side you are moving towards.
- The highlight under the Library filters (All, Installed, Not installed and so on) and the grid and list switch now glide, and the game cards rise in when you change a filter, search, sort or view.
- The same gliding highlight is on the Settings list and its Interface size choice, the News tabs, the Themes filter, the Achievements filter and the banner choice in the profile editor.
- Buttons dip when pressed and spring back, and the sections of each page rise in one after another.
